device_name.description: Name of the Mesa FPGA card (e.g., 7i90, 7i77). If empty, detects based on interface.

interface_type.description: Interface type for connection: ETHER, SPI, USB, SERIAL, EPP, or AUTO.

address.description: IP address (for Ethernet) or device path (for USB/SPI/SERIAL). Required for non-PCI devices.

bitfile_path.description: Path to the FPGA configuration bitfile (.bin) to write. If empty, performs info/read commands.

enable_verify.description: If true, verifies the flash memory against the bitfile after writing.

verbose_mode.description: If true, prints detailed information during execution.

use_fallback.description: If true, uses the fallback area of the FLASH memory.

set_ip_address.description: IP address to set in EEPROM memory (e.g., 192.168.1.100). Only for Ethernet boards.
